title: Fix WORKSPACE env var missing in bench-native.sh
objective: Fix bench-native.sh failing when called directly because it invokes docker compose without the WORKSPACE environment variable set. Added WORKSPACE=${WORKSPACE:-$LAB_DIR} after LAB_DIR assignment so all docker compose calls have the variable available, matching the dc() wrapper pattern used by ./lab.

acceptance_criteria.text: bench-native.sh works when called directly by defaulting WORKSPACE to LAB_DIR.
acceptance_criteria.note: Resolved: one-line fix implemented and merged before the acceptance-criteria policy; verified manually.
